offering_description.value: Provides investment management products to institutions, intermediaries and individual investors. Offers money market funds, fixed income, equity, multi-asset, alternative and ESG strategies through mutual funds, ETFs, separate accounts and collective funds, managed by in-house portfolio teams.

primary_products.value: money market funds; mutual funds; exchange-traded funds; separately managed accounts; collective investment funds

primary_services.value: investment management; fund administration; stewardship and engagement services; liquidity management

customer_segment.value: B2B: institutional investors, corporations, banks, broker-dealers, financial advisors, pension plans, insurers; B2C: individual investors via advisors and intermediaries; B2G: government entities and public funds investing in cash management and bond strategies

end_markets.value: asset management; institutional cash management; retirement savings; wealth management

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: advisory fees based on assets under management in funds and accounts; service fees: administration, distribution and shareholder service fees
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in client assets and invests them in securities across asset classes, sells to institutions, intermediaries and investors

geography_served.value: global: US-based with offices in the UK, Europe and elsewhere, clients across the US, Europe and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: money market, fixed income, equity, multi-asset and private market strategies sharing clients and distribution

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: institutional sales teams serving corporations, banks and public entities; agents / brokers: broker-dealers, banks and financial advisors distributing funds; partners / resellers: intermediaries, platforms and sub-advisory relationships
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; agents / brokers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment adviser and funds regulated by SEC under the Investment Advisers and Investment Company Acts, FCA oversight in the UK
